branch_metadata.branch_rationale: QFT-Einstein bridge note repository default fallback

description: Bridge note: the QFT/electroweak sector and the Einstein/GR sector use the same five causal-wave coefficients and the same finite loop-class library. They differ in the spinor-trace component count n: QFT/Yukawa lives at n=1; Einstein/cosmological observables span n in {0, 1, 2, 4} with the resummed propagator at n=4.

shared_T_parity_source.axiom: T-parity source axiom on the defect field (Xi is T-odd)

Einstein_sector_mapping.note: Cosmological observables span n in {0, 1, 2, 4}. The single-loop Resummed-Propagator (T_RH at n=4) is the only entry whose unaugmented Dirac structure is purely Einstein-side. Most other cosmological observables are tree-level or 2-loop compounds whose dominant n is set by the largest contributing lemma. Omega_DM h^2 is a Sub-Generation closure at n=1 (Lemma 6, 1-gamma/(2*N_gen)), aligned with alpha_s and CKM V_us / V_cb on the QFT side; see the companion loop-class closure paper for the full classification.

shared_falsification_paths.test: alternative T-parity assignment of the defect field flips the sign of the two-loop closure (companion electroweak-scale paper, falsification path F2)
coefficient-reduction constraints C1, C2, C3 under the reduction system R fail to follow Lemma-4 + Lemma-7 forms

structural_claim: The two sectors are NOT independent theories that happen to use similar formulas; they are two regimes (different n) of the same five-coefficient causal-wave transport law with the same loop-class library and the same T-parity source axiom.
non_claim: This bridge does not derive a quantum-gravity UV completion; it is a structural mapping between two emergent sectors.
